say:2:1041503201:1.source_cn: 啊，萨基塔里斯！你又在这里偷懒！

say:3:1041503202:1.text: What a coincidence, Talene. It's been centuries since we last met, right?
say:3:1041503202:1.source_cn: 是塔琳啊，真巧。\n我们是不是有几百年没见过面了？

say:4:1041503203:1.text: I was in a bit of a tough situation—don't change the subject!
say:4:1041503203:1.source_cn: 嗯，我之前稍微出了点状况——\n别岔开话题！

say:5:1041503204:1.text: Loosen up, Talene! How about coming to my party tonight to celebrate our reunion?
say:5:1041503204:1.source_cn: 别这样，塔琳，为了庆祝我们的重逢，今晚要不要来我的宴会？

say:6:1041503205:1.text: I can set up a special spot for you, decorate it with golden and red flowers, and have hundreds of poets sing for you.
say:6:1041503205:1.source_cn: 我可以为你准备一处专场，用黄金和火红的花朵装饰，再请上...

say:7:1041503206:1.text: S-sing? I am not too fond of the popular songs these days; they are too noisy.
say:7:1041503206:1.source_cn: 唱、唱什么？我可不喜欢最近流行的曲子，太吵闹了。

say:8:1041503207:1.text: Don't you trust my taste? Even Scarlita has fun at my parties.
say:8:1041503207:1.source_cn: 你对我的品味还不放心吗？\n连斯克嘉莉德都能在我的宴会...

say:9:1041503208:1.text: Hmm... I guess I've got to style my hair later...
say:9:1041503208:1.source_cn: 哼……那我等会儿就得准备下发型……

say:10:1041503209:1.text: Wait! You're steering the conversation away again!
say:10:1041503209:1.source_cn: 等等！又被你岔开话题了！
